title: Select Your Minimal & Futuristic Direction
question: Three re-thought, minimal, non-vibe-coded visual directions for Nymbus. Zero purple sparkles, zero generic clutter. Select your direction.

options.label: The Spatial Ledger
options.lineage: High-precision architectural drafting & Linear/Raycast functional minimalism
options.thesis: Radical reduction: monumental statement 'AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH. ABSOLUTE PROVENANCE.' with an interactive 3D orthographic drafting plane in Three.js displaying live subtasks and verified source excerpt cards.
options.viewport: Top half: clean masthead & massive typography. Center: interactive 3D isometric plane with subtask nodes and verified paragraph passages.
options.risk: Requires clean camera perspective so isometric text cards remain crisp and legible.

options.label: The Swiss Precision Matrix
options.lineage: International Typographic Style (Vignelli / Aicher modernism) meets algorithmic telemetry
options.thesis: Ruthless typographic architecture: monumental display type 'DECOMPOSE. VERIFY. PROVE.', asymmetric grid columns, kinetic subtask dependency streams, and International Klein Blue citation cards.
options.viewport: Monumental header grid, live scrolling kinetic dependency streams, precision telemetry table, and cryptographic verified citation blocks.
options.risk: Minimalist austerity must remain high-information without feeling cold.

options.label: The Structural Blueprint CAD
options.lineage: Bauhaus technical drafting meets cryptographic proof validation
options.thesis: Surgical drafting precision: CAD coordinate rulers, caliper markings, a central interactive 3D rotating polyhedral wireframe connecting the 5 agents, and expandable cryptographic proof trees.
options.viewport: Drafting HUD: CAD coordinate grid with central 3D rotating knowledge crystal, left sidebar DAG subtask flow, right sidebar proof inspection drawer.
options.risk: CAD aesthetic requires clear interactive feedback on draggable 3D components.
